title: rhodiola rosea subsp. atropurpurea
intro: Rhodiola rosea subsp. atropurpurea, commonly known as the purple leaved rhodiola or red-rooted rhodiola, is a subspecies of the rhodiola rosea plant, a perennial flowering plant native to the Arctic regions of Europe, Asia, and North America. Rhodiola rosea subsp. atropurpurea is known for its adaptogenic and medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving mental performance, and enhancing mood. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include rosavin, salidroside, and tyrosol, that work to modulate the body's stress response and promote overall well-being. By regulating the body's response to stress, rhodiola rosea subsp. atropurpurea is used as a natural remedy to support mental health and resilience.
